scenes.heading: The Folded Notes
scenes.label: ORIGINAL FICTION
scenes.narration: Nina stopped opening the notes her father tucked into her lunch.

speechParts.text: Nina stopped opening the notes her father tucked into her lunch.

scenes.heading: The drawer
scenes.label: SEVENTEEN
scenes.narration: She was seventeen. His little drawings felt embarrassing. Each afternoon, she dropped the folded paper into a drawer.

speechParts.text: Each afternoon, she dropped the folded paper into a drawer.

scenes.heading: An empty space
scenes.label: YEARS LATER
scenes.narration: On her first day at work, years later, she reached for a note. There was none. Her father had died that winter.

scenes.heading: The line underneath
scenes.label: THAT EVENING
scenes.narration: That evening, she opened the drawer. Beneath the jokes was one line, written again and again: I am proud of you.

scenes.heading: A note of her own
scenes.label: THE NEXT MORNING
scenes.narration: The next morning, Nina packed her little brother's lunch. She could not draw like Dad. She folded a note anyway.
